input.question: What channel is NewsChannel 5 affiliated with?

documents.text: WPTV-TV WPTV-TV is an NBC-affiliated television station licensed to West Palm Beach, Florida, United States, serving the Gold and Treasure Coasts of South Florida. It broadcasts a high definition digital signal on VHF channel 12 (or virtual channel 5 via PSIP) from a transmitter in Lake Worth along US 441/SR 7. The station is owned by the E. W. Scripps Company, which also operates Fox affiliate WFLX (channel 29) under a shared services agreement with owner Raycom Media.
